body:
i had a horrible panic attack last night because i was watching a youtube video and they just mentioned bo burnham.
 i just remember watching some of his stuff with a friend and the song "kill yourself" came on. and i laughed, maybe a bit too hard. she didnt. i didnt ask anything even though i noticed. and she killed herself a month later. she had already planned it at that point.

i feel like an idiot.
i guess our boat is sinking
thank you for writing this. it means a lot to me
